name: @neutral/lifecycle-workspace
description: Lifecycle Foundation public source: protocol, canonical CLI, and execution runtime.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @neutral/lifecycle-protocol && npm run build:self -w @neutral/lifecycle-runtime && npm run build:self -w @neutral/lifecycle
scripts.refresh:qualification-manifests: npm run refresh:fixture-manifest && npm run refresh:publication-manifest
scripts.check:built: npm run check:spec && npm run check -w @neutral/lifecycle-protocol && npm run check:self -w @neutral/lifecycle-runtime && npm run check:self -w @neutral/lifecycle
scripts.check: npm run check:schemas -w @neutral/lifecycle-runtime && npm run build && npm run check:built
scripts.test:built: npm run test:built -w @neutral/lifecycle-protocol && npm run test:built -w @neutral/lifecycle-runtime && npm run test:built -w @neutral/lifecycle
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run test:built
